entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Laven Arora, learned counsel for the   Shri Dilip Shrivastava, learned G  respondent/State.
Despite this Court order dated 07.04.2022, State has not submitted any report regarding compliance of provisions of Section 13(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
As prayed by learned Government Advocate, last opportunity is granted to submit the report.

However, it is made clear that if the said report is not made available by the State on the next date,
case may be heard and decided in absence thereof.
Interim relief to continue till the next date of hearing.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Jasleen Kamal Kumar Arora vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/6101748/
